judged_text: Email failure is silently swallowed: catch block logs only a static message, discarding the error object with no stack/message, retry, queue, or user-facing signal

record.issue_text: Email failure is silently swallowed: catch block logs only a static message, discarding the error object with no stack/message, retry, queue, or user-facing signal

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which discards the caught `err` and always returns success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`). This is a concrete observability/robustness issue introduced by the diff: failures to send emails are not surfaced to the caller and the logged message omits the error/stack, making troubleshooting difficult.
